content.text: Image uploads on notes are in. Lint and `next build` pass, but I haven't run an upload against a real bucket, since the credentials are placeholders. **How it works** - **Storage:** an S3-compatible bucket through `@aws-sdk/client-s3`, so AWS S3, Cloudflare R2 and MinIO all work. It lives in `src/lib/storage.ts`. - **Validation:** uploads are limited to 5 MB, and the type is checked from the file's actual bytes (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF). Files are stored under a server-generated key, `notes//.`. - **Users code:** `src/lib/users.ts` now has a `Note` type with `listNotes` and `createNote`. The saved note holds the image URL. - **Dashboard:** `/dashboard` has a notes form (text plus an optional image) that calls a server action, and it lists the notes with their images. - **Config:** `next.config.ts` raises the server-action body limit to 6 MB. `.env.example` has the S3 placeholders (region, bucket, keys, optional endpoint, public base URL), and I added a `!.env.example` line to `.gitignore` so the file isn't ignored. **Things to know** - Notes are kept in memory, like the existing `users` array, so they reset on restart. Swap in a real database when you replace the users. - The bucket must serve objects publicly (or through a CDN) at `S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`, because the saved URL is shown directly in an ``. - `getCurrentUser()` still returns the first user, so every note is attributed to Ada. - `tsc --noEmit` reports one error in `src/app/layout.tsx`, `Cannot find name 'LayoutProps'`. I didn't touch that file, and `next build` still passes. I haven't committed anything.
